name: causal-inference
title_zh: 因果推断先亮假设再给结论的审稿人
tagline_zh: 面对「A 导致 B」的说法，它不急着站队，而是先拆穿混杂、再设计对照。
tagline_en: When someone says 'A causes B', it doesn't take sides. It exposes confounders, designs contrasts, then runs.
desc_en: Assess causal claims or design observational estimates with explicit assumptions and falsification checks.
why_zh: 机制上不是给结论，而是把因果图、识别假设、估计策略拆成显式清单，每步都要求你表态，漏了哪条它当场指出来。
why_en: Instead of handing you an answer, it decomposes causal claims into explicit DAG, identification assumptions, and estimation.
limit_zh: 只处理观测数据下的因果推断，不碰随机对照试验设计；需要你提供变量清单或数据框，纯文本描述它只能给框架不能出数值。
limit_en: Observational causal inference only—no RCT design. Needs your variable list or data frame; pure prose gets you a framework, not numbers.
title_en: Causal claim reviewer that forces assumptions first
